requirement.title: Pump station sub-main: voltage drop and breaker/cable coordination
requirement.statement: The 400 V sub-main to the remote pump station shall keep the total voltage drop from the point of supply to the pump-station terminals within 5 % of 400 V at the design current of 120 A, and the breaker and cable shall be coordinated (Ib <= In <= Iz, with Iz corrected for site ambient temperature).
requirement.source: Site electrical design basis EDB-07, section 3; wiring-rules voltage-drop limit for a supply from the distributor's shared low-voltage network

criteria.quantity: total voltage drop, point of supply to pump-station terminals
coordination utilisation, the larger of Ib/In and In/Iz

card.load_case: Balanced three-phase, 400 V, 50 Hz. Design current 120 A per phase (assessed maximum demand 100 A plus the site's 20 % spare allowance) at 0.85 lagging power factor. Installed route length 400 m. 1.2 % of voltage drop is already used elsewhere between the point of supply and the load. Site ambient: 50 C shaded air, 35 C soil at 0.5 m.

check.author: R. Tan
stated_limits: earth-fault loop impedance and disconnection time at the far end
short-circuit withstand of the cable and breaking capacity of the breaker
the overload tripping condition I2 <= 1.45 Iz and breaker settings
grouping with other circuits, solar gain, and soil other than 1.2 K.m/W at 0.5 m
whether the maximum demand, the route length and the 1.2 % used elsewhere are themselves right

controls.name: 50 mm2 on ladder, 125 A: voltage drop must fail (about double the limit)
150 mm2 buried, 100 A breaker: coordination must fail (Ib 120 A above In 100 A)
150 mm2 buried, 125 A: both must pass (a size outside the approved list, used only to show the check can pass)
